final_core_selection.spec_definition: Family plus training schedule plus fixed epoch plus raw/EMA variant
final_core_selection.ranking_metric: Arithmetic mean pooledFID across confirmation seeds123 and314 at each fixed spec
final_core_selection.winner: Lowest confirmation mean among the nine fixed specs using declared ties
final_core_selection.seed42_role: Selects families and checkpoint/mode specs; excluded from the primary confirmation ranking mean
final_core_selection.all_three_mean: Descriptive reporting only; not a replacement selection score
final_core_selection.representative: For the winning fixed spec, select the median-validation-FID checkpoint among seeds42/123/314 using the declared deterministic seed tie rule
final_core_selection.c0f_comparator_rule: Apply the same fixed-spec ranking to C0F's eligible fixed specs, then the same three-seed median representative rule; freeze the exact resulting C0F checkpoint before test
final_core_selection.c0f_interpretation: Matched fresh training-and-selection-procedure control; its selected epoch/mode/representative seed may differ from the winner

SHA256 of original epoch95 baseline, C0F representative and winner representative
Metric protocol, source/data/validation-manifest hashes and prior identities

final_test.reference_rule: Use4000 of the4104 original test images not included in the historical4096 test references; verify disjointness by exact indices/hashes
final_test.prior_rule: Fresh frozen test prior vectors common to every tested model, independent of training/validation/preview priors
final_test.identical_checkpoint_deduplication: If winner equals C0F by checkpoint hash, reuse the same evaluation artifact rather than regenerate or retest
final_test.disclosure: Report historical test use/any prior inspection; validation results never become independent test results
final_test.prohibition: No family/epoch/mode/seed/preprocessing changes or renewed selection based on test results

failure_and_coverage.no_quiet_drops: All19 screening labels, required confirmation/extension/decay runs and separateRGB128 demo retain explicit intended/prepared/running/failed/completed statuses and evidence
failure_and_coverage.no_promising_only_omissions: All user-authorized ideas execute as intended; original optional/conditional wording informs interpretation rather than automatic exclusion
failure_and_coverage.nonfinite_or_missing_metrics: Mark ineligible with preserved cause; no zero imputation and no substitute epoch chosen from confirmation outcomes
failure_and_coverage.failed_screening_run: Preserve evidence, investigate and record bounded repair; if irrecoverable rank next eligible family by the existing screening rule, without hiding the failed family
failure_and_coverage.insufficient_eligible_families: Do not silently alter shortlist size or criteria; record incomplete protocol execution and review before final selection
failure_and_coverage.failed_C0F_or_confirmation_seed: A one-seed result cannot stand in for the required two-seed confirmation mean; resolve or report confirmation incomplete
failure_and_coverage.incomplete_deadline_work: Report unfinished scientific work explicitly; prepared scripts, smoke tests or successful exits do not establish model quality

interpretation_limits: Repeated family/spec selection introduces optimism even after matching checkpoint search opportunities
Using seed42 to select families and epoch/mode specs conditions the subsequent study; report seed42 separately
The confirmation mean of only two seeds is a noisy selection statistic and is not an unbiased population family-performance estimate
Choosing the final winner among nine confirmation-ranked specs introduces additional confirmation-set selection
The median-validation representative is deliberately selected, not a randomly sampled training seed
The final test describes frozen selected checkpoints; cross-seed robustness remains validation evidence
Finite-sample FID bias and ImageNet-feature/domain limitations persist; real-real FID is context, not a universal significance cutoff
Equal epochs do not mean equal optimizer-update counts or GPU cost across T3, widths and regularizers
Do not claim individual penalty attribution without matched noBN controls and the relevant ablations

bindings.ema_buffer_policy: Average all floating parameters and buffers; copy integer counters; EMA inference in eval mode
